deadline.value: Overseas applicants for September 2027 entry must apply by 31 July 2027.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must discuss your proposal with a Bristol supervisor and submit a completed Supervisor Suitability Form with your application.
supervisor.quote: This form should be completed in collaboration with a University of Bristol supervisor. We will not be able to proceed with your application until we have received a completed copy of this document.

also.quote: You need to contact a potential supervisor to discuss available projects

funding.value: A number of funded studentships are available each year; self-funded students are also welcome.
funding.quote: A number of funded studentships are available each year, supported by research council, industry, University or other funds.

entry_route.value: A Merit at master's level is expected; applicants with a first-class bachelor's only on an exceptional basis.
entry_route.quote: PhD applicants must hold/achieve a minimum of a Merit at master's degree level (or international equivalent) in a relevant discipline. Applicants without a master's qualification may be considered on an exceptional basis, provided they hold a first class undergraduate degree.

toefl_min.value: English profile E. TOEFL iBT tests from 21 Jan 2026: 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills (older tests: 88 overall).
toefl_min.quote: For tests taken from 21 January 2026 onwards: 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills

also.quote: If English is not your first language, you will need to reach the requirements outlined in our profile level E.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no score below 6.0 (profile E).

also.quote: If English is not your first language, you will need to reach the requirements outlined in our profile level E.
